summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the fully-rewritten /services/music-meditation page. All 93 assertions passed covering hero, Why Music Wellness (6 cards), Choose Your Wellness Journey (2 ChoiceCards), tab-driven Program Explorer (only one panel at a time, default individual, fade class present), Individual panel (elements, program structure, outcomes, 3 plan cards ₹799/₹999/₹1499, international-pricing note), Corporate panel (6 why-items, RESET/REGULATE/RESTORE journey, outcomes, exactly the 6 required delivery-format items with NO fixed participant counts), all CTA scroll+tab-toggle wiring (hero, choice cards, in-panel primary CTAs, plan-choose preselecting plan value, bottom banner), dynamic booking form (individual vs corporate switching, correct submit labels), successful individual + corporate submissions with success card and localStorage persistence (udukku.bookings + udukku.contacts), FAQ (5 rows, only one open at a time, click behaviour). Regression sanity on /services (hero-only, 4 service links, no footer), /services/music-room, /services/events and / homepage – all still render without console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: MusicMeditation.jsx is 926 lines – consider splitting IndividualPanel, CorporatePanel, IndividualForm, CorporateForm, and content-data constants into separate files for maintainability (still fine functionally).
openBooking('individual', plan) mutates ind.plan but never clears it when opening without a plan – acceptable behaviour, just noting.
Success card only re-renders form after switching kind; there is no explicit 'Make another booking' CTA on the same kind. Not a bug per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All music-meditation acceptance criteria verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Mocked services: bookingService.create -> localStorage 'udukku.bookings'; contactService.create -> localStorage 'udukku.contacts'. Fade animation uses class 'tab-panel' with keyframe 'udukku-fade'.
